about: Dottore (Torino 1787, «Del giuoco del Dottore», pp. 75-76), the game for five that the book describes in passing: dealt as Permesso for five (15 cards, 18 to the dealer who puts away three), but «non si chiamano, nè si cambiano carte» and «ognuno giuoca il suo giuoco»: each for himself, and the most points wins. The cards are counted one by one, two by two or three by three as the players agree (p. 75). The payment, the value of each card, the lead of the first hand and the count of the Fool are not printed; those are ours, marked. Giuoco sciolto of Sestilio uses these rules.

dummett1980.cite: Michael Dummett, The Game of Tarot, London: Duckworth, 1980, chapter XIII «Tarocco in Piedmont and Lombardy», pp. 258-279 (our scan is partial: printed page 268 is missing)

torino1846.cite: L. B., Il giuocatore di tarocchi al tavoliere, part I (Grammatica del giuocatore), Torino, Serra, [1846]

count.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 76: «al Dottore si giuoca pure tra cinque persone».

direction.source: [D] Torino 1787, pp. 35, 37: «gli altri sempre a destra procedendo»: play passes to the right.

first_dealer.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 16 (general rule): cards are turned up and «se viene prima da questa parte un Trionfo, mischierò io»; the game sections themselves do not repeat who deals first, so the general rule is carried over.

cut_by.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 58 (Permesso, said before the deal): «ed a sinistra coppati»; who cuts is not named. Read with the general rule of pp. 16-18 as the player on the dealer's left; other reading: only the direction of the cut is meant.

cut_min.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 17: «Una carta sola non si può coppare»: a cut leaves at least two cards in each part.

dealer_rotation.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 70: after a hand that «si deve ripigliar da capo» «tocca al compagno appresso a mischiare, e dar i Tarocchi»: the next player deals; the book names no other change of dealer, and «appresso» is read in the direction of play (to the right).

mode.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «ognuno giuoca il suo giuoco»; «Chi fa più punti è quel, che guadagna».

signals.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 73: knocks and signs are barred «a qualunque altro giuoco di Tarocchi».

deck.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 75: dealt as Permesso for five (p. 74), 5 × 15 + 3 = 78; the sum is not printed.

trump_order.source: [D] Torino 1787, pp. 9-10, 13: the trionfi rank by their printed numbers, with the Angel XX above the World XXI («l'usanza, che in questo caso fa legge»); checked on the scan on 2 November 2026.

suit_order.source: [D] Torino 1787, pp. 11-13: swords and batons run 10 down to 1, cups and coins 1 up to 10, the courts above every numeral in the order King, Queen, Knight, Jack; checked on the scan on 2 November 2026.

card_points.source: [R] Torino 1787, pp. 13-14: king 5, queen 4, knight 3, jack 2, Angel, Bagatto, Fool 5; plain cards counted with a figure in pairs (p. 52), our reading.

fool.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 77: «Il Folle a questi tre giuochi solamente … non volendo noi giuocar altra carta»: shown instead of a card, it takes nothing (Quintilio, Sestilio, Settilio).

fool_exchange.source: [R] Torino 1787, pp. 75-78: the Dottore says nothing of the Fool; pp. 76-77 give giuoco sciolto, which uses the Dottore's rules, the Fool's card (pp. 77-78). Carried over to the Dottore itself; other reading: no card for the Fool at the Dottore.

fool_exchange_card.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 52: «una cartaccia, qualunque gli piaccia»; carried over to the three games of pp. 77-78.

fool_exchange_to.source: [D] Torino 1787, pp. 77-78: «dovrà sempre dare a chi ha preso … quando il Folle è stato giuocato»: to the taker of the trick in which the Fool was shown.

fool_no_tricks.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 50: «non sarò io obbligato a dartelo mai»; Prammatica [1846], p. 6 disagrees («cederlo»), not followed.

replace.what: the Fool of a player who won no trick: kept or given up

options.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «Nel contare poi i … a due a … tutti contino sull'istesso metodo»; the default is ours.
[S] Torino 1787, pp. 75-76: the Dottore names no payment («Chi fa più punti è quel, che guadagna»); the stake is agreed before the deal (general rule, p. 21); the choices are ours.

hand_size.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 46: «Si danno quindici carte»; Torino 1787, p. 75 only by reference.

dealer_extra.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «se ne scartano tre da chi dà le carte secondo il solito»: three over for the dealer.

packets.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 59 (said for Permesso): the way of dealing is the dealer's, announced before the cut.

packets_announced.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 59: announced before the cut; the Dottore sends to Permesso for the deal.

phases.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «se ne scartano tre da chi dà le carte secondo il solito».

who.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «da chi dà le carte».

count_mode.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «tre»; as in Permesso for five (p. 74).

discard_honours_barred.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 75: «secondo il solito»: as usual, the honours are not put away (general rule 38, p. 34).

allowed_exceptions.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 34 (rule 38): «eccetto che Bagatto sia solo, senza il Folle»: «solo» is read as the only trump of the hand, as Dummett 1980, p. 259 reads this rule («neither the Folle nor any other trump»). Revision 1 read it as «holding no Fool». Other reading: no exception, as the rules of 1830 have it (Dummett, p. 259).

counts_for.source: [S] Torino 1787, pp. 75-76 do not say whose points the discard joins; ours, as in Venticinque (p. 55): the dealer's.

replace.what: the discard of a player who won no trick: kept or lost

announce.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 60 (Permesso): after the words the discard cannot change; «secondo il solito».

first_leader.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 75: «Chi è ultimo a prendere giuoca il primo, come si è detto del giuoco Trent'uno»; the rule is on p. 37 (said for Sedici): «Colui, che or ultimo ha preso la mano … deve essere il primo a giuocare». Other reading: the last to receive cards; the lead of the first hand is not said (the general rule of p. 35 gives it to the player on the dealer's right).

replace.what: who leads first: «Chi è ultimo a prendere giuoca il primo»

next_leader.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 37: «Colui, che or ultimo ha preso la mano … deve essere il primo a giuocare».

follow_suit.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 35: «debbon rispondere con carte della medesima sequenza».

must_trump.source: [D] Torino [1846], part I, p. 36, for Partita and «anche negli altri giuochi»: «si risponderà e prenderà con un Trionfo». Torino 1787, p. 36 only shows it.

must_overtrump.source: [R] Torino 1787, pp. 36-37: no duty to beat the trump on the table.

fool_may_lead.source: [S] Ours: the Fool «solamente si mostra, quando cada in acconcio» (p. 77) at the three Permesso games; for the Dottore the book is silent.

count_unit.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 75: counted «ad una ad una, o a due a due, o a tre a tre»; the half-point arithmetic of the format covers all three.

group.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «purchè tutti contino sull'istesso metodo»: one, two or three by agreement (option group).

odd_card.source: [S] Torino 1787, p. 75 does not say how cards left over a whole group count; ours: as at Venticinque (p. 54), the odd card counts its value less the half.

fool_card.source: [S] Torino 1787, p. 75 is silent on the Fool's card; ours: counted.

plain_value.source: [R] Torino 1787, p. 75: counting one by one makes every plain card worth a point; Dummett 1980, p. 263: «so that there are 130 points altogether».

winner.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 75: «Chi fa più punti è quel, che guadagna».

tie.source: [S] Torino 1787, p. 75 does not say what equal points are worth; ours: no one gains, the hand is replayed.

game_points.source: [S] Torino 1787, p. 75 names no game points; the hand is settled in stakes.

unit.source: [S] Torino 1787, pp. 75-76: no payment is printed (Dummett 1980, p. 263: «no system of payment in PE»); the agreed stake.

mode.source: [S] Torino 1787, p. 75: not said; ours: each of the four others pays the winner (as Sedici for three, p. 43).

amount.source: [S] Torino 1787, p. 75: not said; the simple stake agreed before the deal (general rule, p. 21).

kind.source: [S] Ours: the book describes one hand; the table keeps accounts until the players leave.

effect.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 38 (general rule 35, said for Sedici; p. 79 (Meno) and p. 90 (Partita) send to it): «incorrere nella pena accennata … num. 35. di … tutti i giuocatori compagni»; the engine refuses a card that does not follow suit.

[D] Torino 1787, p. 73: «costui pagherà la partita semplice a tutti … giuocare, o far cessare il giuoco»; named for Permesso for three, four and five and for Chiamare il Re (and «a qualunque altro giuoco di Tarocchi»). [R] who the offender may be is not said (any player); the table cannot see a knock, so only the rules page tells it.

left_out.source: [D] Torino 1787, p. 76: «al Dottore si giuoca pure tra cinque persone».
left_out.why: The book names only five players; other numbers are not offered.
